title: UK Space Agency- Strategic Support to the International Charter: Space and Major Disasters
description:
The International Charter: Space and Major Disasters (“the Charter”) is a global agreement which aims to provide a unified system of space data acquisition and delivery to those affected by natural or man-made disasters. It provides and enables transmission of earth observation satellite data and pre-authorised resilience/emergency response bodies in response to “activations”. Further details on the Charter can be found at https://disasterscharter.org/.
Charter members are national government bodies/ agencies or recognised space system organisations, who are the owners/ operators of earth observation satellite missions and have access to contributing resources/ assets/ facilities to sustainability support, co-ordinate and govern ongoing Charter operations. These members and their partners all strive to meet the common goal of providing assured, co-ordinated and timely access to satellite data to assist recognised rescue/ resilience authorities in the event of a natural or manmade disaster to ultimately help minimise losses and save lives. 
The UK has been a Charter member since 2005 and wishes to continue to play an active leadership role in this highly regarded and valued global initiative. To meet our agreed national obligations to our international partners, end users within the UK Government and its’ partners, UK Space Agency (UKSA) has an enduring requirement for the provision of Strategic Support, and ongoing technical/specialist Operational Support to support ongoing satellite imagery provision as these technical capabilities and specialist skills do not currently exist/reside within UKSA. 
 This will ensure that the UK continues to meet its obligations to this international agreement, whilst also continuing to make the best use of UK assets and resources. However please note that the UK Operational Support aspects of this role will not form part of this procurement opportunity, and instead will be provided under a separate contract. This specification refers only to those requirements necessary for the strategic support role. This role will involve significant interaction between UKSA (now a directorate within the Department for Science, Innovation and Technology (DSIT)), UK Government stakeholders, the Charter Executive Secretariat and the UK Operational Support provider.
